network_WlanDriver: make it fatal if no devices are found We want to use this as a litmus test for basic driver support in the BVT suite. But currently, it gives a Pass (TestNA) for a device with no Wifi driver loaded. This is bad, since it doesn't catch one of various failure modes: (a) driver is not enabled, when it should be (b) driver is poorly written and fails to initialize reliably (c) other drivers (e.g., cfg80211.ko duplication) prevent our driver from loading These are things we should catch. Let's go with the following rule: if you disable shill's Wifi support (USE="-wifi"), then we'll forgive you. But if you enable Wifi support, we expect to find a supported Wifi device. BUG=chromium:793526 TEST=$subject test, on devices with (a) unsupported driver -> FAIL (b) supported driver, but removed (rmmod) -> FAIL (c) no shill/wifi support (USE="-wifi") -> TEST_NA (d) supported driver, properly initialized -> PASS Change-Id: I54277d8ab12f2c65f7a2c7c9aa8cc79956d61e83 Signed-off-by: Brian Norris <briannorris@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/890121 Tested-by: Kirtika Ruchandani <kirtika@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Kirtika Ruchandani <kirtika@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Eric Caruso <ejcaruso@chromium.org>

wacom_fw_flash: Add hardware id detect option for touch support multi-source panel The standalone touch firmware updating tool "wacom_flash" is used to update firmware and query firmware versions for Wacom touch controllers. Currently, the Wacom touch controllers do not support read-only hardware id in it's flash area. For touch to support multi-source panel. Wacom need change the firmware structure to save hardware id in protected flash area. But this ability also need PCBA changed and use jig to update new boot loader into wacom touch ic. Wacom start this new firmware structure from project soraka, Wacom need update wacom_flash program to add option for read hardware id. This CL pulls down the newest version of wacom_flash from github, This wacom_flash program (release v1.2) add two more options "-p" and "-h" for print product id and hardware id. It allow the auto-updating scripts to use these new option to check the hardware id in the Wacom touch controllers. Here is the usage: wacom_flash version 1.2 Usage: $wacom_flash [firmware filename] [option] [i2c-device path] Ex: $wacom_flash W9013_056.hex -a i2c-1 Run $wacom_flash dummy -a i2c-1 for get active firmware version Run $wacom_flash dummy -p i2c-1 for get product id (PID) in hex, for ex, 50C1 means 0x50C1 Run $wacom_flash dummy -h i2c-1 for get hardware id in hex "vvvv_pppp", means vendor id + "_" + product id Run $wacom_flash firmware-2d1f-4877_0604.hex 1 i2c-1 to update to version firmware-2d1f-4877_0604.hex Here is the program output localhost scripts # wacom_flash dummy -a i2c-6 Returning active firmware version only get_hid_desc failed to send messages Length:30 bcdVer:0x100 RPLength:0x3c4 RPRegister:2 InputReg:3 MaxInput:42 OutReg:0 MaxOut:0 ComReg:4 DataReg:5 VID:0x2d1f PID:0x4877 wVer:0x604 ResvH:0 ResvL0 AES found: addr 0xa 394240 localhost scripts # wacom_flash dummy -p i2c-6 Returning PID only get_hid_desc failed to send messages Length:30 bcdVer:0x100 RPLength:0x3c4 RPRegister:2 InputReg:3 MaxInput:42 OutReg:0 MaxOut:0 ComReg:4 DataReg:5 VID:0x2d1f PID:0x4877 wVer:0x604 ResvH:0 ResvL0 AES found: addr 0xa 4877 localhost scripts # wacom_flash dummy -h i2c-6 Returning HWID only get_hid_desc failed to send messages Length:30 bcdVer:0x100 RPLength:0x3c4 RPRegister:2 InputReg:3 MaxInput:42 OutReg:0 MaxOut:0 ComReg:4 DataReg:5 VID:0x2d1f PID:0x4877 wVer:0x604 ResvH:0 ResvL0 AES found: addr 0xa 2d1f_4877 CQ-DEPEND=CL:434337 BUG=b:64236305 TEST=build the wacom_flash program and test manually at soraka Change-Id: I68d6b05908f342c5479798d6e0b349f9855ca6c2 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/753567 Commit-Ready: Rajat Jain <rajatja@chromium.org> Tested-by: Rajat Jain <rajatja@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Nicolas Boichat <drinkcat@chromium.org>
